name: SENDAI
recent: Eversendai 在 2026 年 10 月因认股权证转换而多次发行新股，同时大股东 Vahana Holdings 与董事 Tan Sri Dato' Nathan A/L Elumalay 的持股出现变动。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收同比减半，并转为净亏损。
notable: 认股权证转换为普通股，分别于 2025 年 10 月 22 日及 24 日上市 83,650 股和 51,400 股新股。
大股东 Vahana Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 及董事 Tan Sri Dato' Nathan A/L Elumalay 的持股出现变动。
risks: 最新季度由盈转亏，净亏损 1,062.8 万令吉。
营收同比下滑 48.3%，环比下滑 44.5%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 2.848 亿令吉，同比下滑 48.3%、环比下滑 44.5%；净亏损 1,062.8 万令吉，净利率为 -3.7%，而上一季度净利率为 0.5%。

recent_en: Eversendai issued new shares multiple times in October 2026 from warrant conversions, while substantial shareholder Vahana Holdings and director Tan Sri Dato' Nathan A/L Elumalay saw changes in their holdings. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue halve year-on-year and swing to a net loss.
notable_en: Warrants were converted into ordinary shares, with 83,650 and 51,400 new shares listed on 22 and 24 October 2025 respectively.
Substantial shareholder Vahana Holdings Sdn. Bhd. and director Tan Sri Dato' Nathan A/L Elumalay recorded changes in their shareholdings.
risks_en: The latest quarter swung to a net loss of MYR 10.628 million from a profit.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 284.8 million, down 48.3% year-on-year and 44.5% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 10.628 million with a net margin of -3.7%, versus a net margin of 0.5% in the prior quarter.
